|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List of 2013, which prints the original release-sheet words again. The image here is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1282-25-front-master.png]]).
* '''Original''' ([[You Will Take Me To Jabba Now (V)]]): Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet, official text as of 14 September 2012<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 14 September 2012"; copy re-made 18 October 2012), page 4, slip 25 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep stacked on your Objective in Used Pile. ▼ Seeking An Audience or an alien to Audience Chamber (for -1 Force). OR Reveal up to 3 aliens stacked on I Know That Laugh or from hand (X = number of aliens revealed); activate X Force.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p4-81-You_Will_Take_Me_To_Jabba_Now.png]]) prints it. The slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[You Will Take Me To Jabba Now (V) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 8 list, in every archived capture with game text, 12 December 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1282_25">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock8Type (Virtual Block 8 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep stacked on your Objective in Used Pile. May ▼ Seeking An Audience or an alien to Audience Chamber (for -1 Force). OR Reveal up to 3 Aliens stacked on I Know That Laugh or from hand (X = number of aliens revealed); activate X Force.” '''What changed:''' Two changes: “May” is added before the ▼, and the first “aliens” is written “Aliens”, with a capital A. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 37)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=37 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1282-25-front-master.png]]: “When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep stacked on your Objective in Used Pile. ▼ Seeking An Audience or an alien to Audience Chamber (for -1 Force). OR Reveal up to 3 aliens stacked on I Know That Laugh or from hand (X = number of aliens revealed); activate X Force.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The Master List slip prints no slip number. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[You Will Take Me To Jabba Now (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-youwilltakemetojabbanow-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 7 May 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual8-Light">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual8-Light/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 7 May 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034752/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep stacked on your Objective in Used Pile. ▼ Seeking An Audience or an alien to Audience Chamber (for -1 Force). OR Reveal up to 3 aliens stacked on I Know That Laugh or from hand (X = number of aliens revealed); activate X Force.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the Master List, PC-E2). The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). Like the release-sheet slip, it prints no slip number.
